about: A converter between LaTeX and Typst documents, in both directions.

prs.title: LaTeX quotes and email addresses convert to valid Typst
prs.broken: LaTeX-style quote marks and email addresses were copied straight into Typst, where those characters mean something else. Ordinary text gave a file that would not compile.
prs.changed: I made the converter turn LaTeX quotes into real curly quotes and escape the at sign in text.
prs.matters: Plain papers with quotes or an email in a footnote now convert and compile.
